Section 3.  Tenant’s Covenants.  Tenant covenants and agrees: (a) to maintain all licenses and permits required for Tenant’s medical operations; (b) upon expiration or termination of this Lease, to remove its personal property and effects and to surrender the Leased Premises to Landlord in accordance with Article XVII; and (c) to comply with all applicable laws relating to Tenant’s specific use and occupancy of the Leased Premises, including applicable healthcare licensure and patient privacy laws.

Tenant shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Landlord and its members, managers, property manager, and lender from claims, losses, costs, and liabilities arising from Hazardous Materials introduced, released, or disposed of by Tenant or its employees, agents, contractors, patients, or invitees, excluding pre-Commencement contamination and contamination migrating from offsite that was not caused or exacerbated by Tenant; this obligation shall survive expiration or earlier termination of this Lease.
